main.content:
==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:bf|assets|tree=1}}
{{back-formation|en|assets}}, from {{der|en|xno|asetz}}, from {{der|en|fro|assez||enough}}. Compare {{cog|enm|asseth}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈæsɛt/|a=UK,CA}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈæsɛt/|/ˈæsət/|a=US}}
** {{rhymes|en|æsɛt|s=2}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈæset/|a=AU}}
** {{audio|en|En-au-asset.ogg|a=Queensland}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q46737}} A thing or quality that has [[value]], especially one that generates cash flows.
#: {{ux|en|My '''assets''' consist of stocks in companies that pay a dividend, and a few apartments that pay me rental income.}}
#* '''January 31 2020''', {{w|Boris Johnson}}, Brexit Day speech
#: {{cot|en|liability}}
## {{lb|en|accounting}} Any item recorded on the [[left-hand]] side of a [[balance sheet]].
##: {{cot|en|liability}}
# {{lb|en|software}} Any [[component]], [[model]], [[process]] or [[framework]] of [[value]] that can be [[leverage]]d or [[reuse]]d.
# {{lb|en|espionage}} An [[intelligence asset]].
# {{lb|en|slang|usually|in the plural}} A woman's [[breasts]] or [[buttocks]] or a man's [[genitalia]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2009|author=Kaitlynn Maguire; Margaret Tingley|title=Serendipitous Moments of Female Sensuality|page=27
|passage=Perhaps it is simply common for wives to want their female friends to see their husband nude – especially if he has nice '''assets'''. Honestly, I also wanted to see the dick of Brian and Andrew.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2009|author=Cheyenne McCray|title=The First Sin: A Lexi Steele Novel|page=189
|passage=“Slave Alexi has nice '''assets'''.”}}
